test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 27 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is ***Option 1)***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"ettiquete"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is "***etiquette*"**. (शिष्टाचार)

 
 
• **Example:** Proper ***etiquette*** dictates that we should thank our hosts before leaving the party.
 
 
 
• **"Etiquette" **refers to the customary code of polite behavior in society or among members of a particular profession or group. (शिष्टाचार)
 
 
• **Example:** Good ***etiquette*** requires that you reply to invitations promptly.
 
 

Therefore, the correct spelling is ***'etiquette'.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Rationalisation** (तर्कसंगतिकरण): The action of attempting to explain or justify behavior or an attitude with logical reasons, even if these are not appropriate.

 
 
• **Example:** The company's ***rationalisation*** efforts led to significant cost savings.
 
 
 
• **Elopement** (भागकर विवाह करना): The act of running away secretly to get married, typically without parental consent.
 
 
• **Example:** Their sudden ***elopement*** surprised everyone, including their closest friends.
 
 
 
• **Occasion** (अवसर): A particular event, or the time at which it happens.
 
 
• **Example:** The wedding was a grand ***occasion ***attended by hundreds of guests.
 
 

391:Tc2e,

The correct answer is **Option 2)**</p
